This practice of self-monitoring became institutionalized as control no longer relied solely on episodic audits but was reinforced in everyday practice and through training programs. In 1988, for instance, one training center—led by the aforementioned Zenovia Niculescu—stressed the importance of (self-)reporting as a core competency of socialist cultural management.

Cultural directors once again occupied a paradoxical subject position, yet this time power operated not only through external directives but through voluntary self-regulation, in which meeting targets and documenting their fulfillment became inseparable. Crucially, however, it was the continuous production of documentation—rendering such achievement verifiable and institutionally valid—that carried independent weight. In this sense, a regime of epistemic surveillance was not merely imposed from above but sustained through the routine production of reports and (self-)evaluations, which translated institutional life into an ongoing demonstration of economic and ideological alignment alike.
zh: 因此，分权可被视为社会主义治理的一项技术。它把责任向下转移，强化参与式的自我监测和个人问责，使地方机构几乎别无选择，只能记录自身绩效，同时仍然受中央优先事项约束。自我监测实践逐渐制度化，因为控制不再仅靠偶发审计，而是在日常实践和培训项目中不断强化。例如，1988年，由前述泽诺维娅·尼古列斯库领导的一所培训中心，强调报告及自我报告是社会主义文化管理的核心能力。
文化主管再次占据一种悖论性的主体位置，但这一次，权力不仅通过外部指令运行，也通过自愿的自我规制发挥作用：完成指标与记录指标完成情况变得不可分割。然而，关键在于，持续生产文件本身具有独立分量，因为文件使成就可被核实，并在制度上获得效力。从这个意义上说，知识层面的监视体制并非只是自上而下强加的，也通过报告及自我评价的日常生产得以维系；这些文件把机构生活转化为对经济和意识形态双重一致性的持续展示。

en: The Daia Română report elucidates something else on top of this. It concluded with the remark that this type of fiasco was not an isolated occurrence but indicative of systemic shortcomings in uneven local implementation and irregular oversight. In Sebeș, for instance, the director of the house of culture admitted that “the council does not meet as regularly as desired, but only when major actions are at stake,” adding that the issue would be addressed “in a future council meeting,” though without specifying when.

Inspecting authorities noted such procedural approximation as a shortcoming in itself, alongside what they described as a tendency to work in a “sectarian” manner, with participation limited to only a few of the council’s seventeen members.
zh: 达亚罗默讷的报告还进一步说明了另一点。报告结论指出，这类惨败并非孤例，而是地方实施不均、监督不规律等系统性缺陷的表现。例如，在塞贝什，文化宫主任承认‘委员会开会没有达到所希望的频率，只在面临重大行动时才开’，并补充说这一问题将在‘今后某次委员会会议上’处理，却没有说明时间。
检查当局认为，这种程序上的含糊本身就是缺陷，另一个缺陷是他们所称的‘宗派式’工作倾向：委员会17名成员中只有少数参与。

en: Deficiencies of this sort did not go unaddressed and set a circuit of disciplinary measures in motion. Authorities attributed them to broader weaknesses in the functioning of local popular councils, which, “lacking sufficient oversight from the party, have become merely formal structures.” As a remedy, inspectors recommended supplementary managerial training to correct ineffective leadership. They proposed that “successful practices developed at the County Committee for Culture and Socialist Education be extended to all cultural leadership councils across the county.”

In addition to contradicting the implied autonomy of decentralization, such prescriptions reveal a cyclical dynamic in which organizational failures were framed as training deficits, which, in turn, justified further interventions and thereby reproduced the very managerial dependence and institutional fragility that reforms were meant to overcome.
zh: 这类缺陷并未被置之不理，而是启动了一套纪律措施的循环。当局将其归因于地方人民委员会运作上的更广泛弱点：这些委员会‘缺少党充分监督，已变成徒具形式的结构’。作为补救，检查者建议追加管理培训，以纠正无效领导。他们提出，‘应把县文化与社会主义教育委员会形成的成功做法推广到全县所有文化领导委员会。’
这些处方不仅与分权所隐含的自主相矛盾，也揭示一种循环动态：组织失败被表述为培训不足，培训不足又为进一步干预提供理由，从而再生产了改革原本想克服的管理依赖与机构脆弱性。

en: Caught in this recursive bind—a self-iterative cycle of dependencies—cultural labor and the management of resources became inseparable from their own documentation. This conflation made the paper trail of financial targets as important as achieving them. Audits, reports, metrics, and formal planning procedures became integral to institutional practice rather than external checks upon it. More than simply instituting the principle of self-financing, the policies encoded a multilayered regime of performance accountability, in which excessive bureaucratization both reshaped and redistributed control, while inculcating accountability as an intrinsic feature of cultural administration. Bureaucratization thus ceased to be incidental to the self-financing regime and became its essence, with paperwork functioning as the abiding machinery of governance.
zh: 陷入这种递归式束缚——一种依赖关系自我迭代的循环——后，文化劳动与资源管理变得同对它们自身的记录不可分离。这种混同使财务目标留下的文书轨迹与实现目标同样重要。审计、报告、指标和正式计划程序成为机构实践的内在组成部分，而不是对它的外部检查。政策所做的不只是确立自筹经费原则，而是编码出一套多层次绩效问责体制：过度官僚化既重塑又重新分配控制，同时把问责灌输为文化行政的内在特征。因此，官僚化不再是自筹经费体制的附带现象，而成为其本质，文书工作则作为持久的治理机器发挥作用。

en: Epilogue: From One Crisis to Another
zh: 尾声：从一场危机到另一场危机

en: What emerged in Romania’s cultural sector during the 1980s was neither the retreat of socialism nor the premature arrival of capitalism but a distinctive experiment in governing crisis. Introduced as a response to mounting external debt, the self-financing regime instituted novel forms of financial accountability, managerial retraining, and audit practices designed to render institutions responsible for their own economic viability and to contribute to the broader effort of stabilizing the national economy. While culture did not come to a standstill under these pressures (austerity reshaped creative practice rather than extinguishing it), the production of culture and the criteria that underpinned its legitimacy were nonetheless altered: revenue thresholds, productivity quotas, and audience figures served as revised measures of institutional success. Once translated into practice, however, these imperatives rarely operated coherently or uniformly. They were improvised and unevenly absorbed across institutions, and in doing so exposed the contradictions at the core of late-socialist governance.
zh: 1980年代罗马尼亚文化部门出现的，既不是社会主义退却，也不是资本主义提前到来，而是一场独特的危机治理实验。为回应不断攀升的外债而引入的自筹经费体制，建立了新形式的财务问责、管理再培训和审计实践，意在使机构对自身经济生存负责，并为稳定国民经济的更广泛努力作贡献。文化在这些压力下并未停滞——紧缩重塑了创作实践，而非将其熄灭——但文化生产以及支撑其正当性的标准仍发生改变：收入门槛、生产率指标和观众数字，成为重新规定机构成功的尺度。然而，这些要求一经转化为实践，很少能一致或统一地运作。各机构临机实施并不均衡地吸收它们，由此暴露社会主义晚期治理核心的矛盾。

en: Rather than a by-product of reform or evidence of systemic incoherence, contradiction functioned as the operative mechanism that made cultural governance workable in practice precisely by sustaining late socialism’s internal and external tensions: (1) institutions were expected to be economically self-sufficient while remaining embedded in socialist structures of redistribution; (2) cultural actors were compelled to act entrepreneurially within an ideological framework that formally disavowed profit and market competition; (3) managerial retraining sought to produce self-optimizing economic actors, yet did so within a system still grounded in political loyalty that kept actors accountable as socialist functionaries; and (4) decentralization promised greater autonomy, yet in practice it extended reporting obligations and intensified bureaucratic oversight, which made paperwork a condition of administrative survival.
zh: 矛盾并非改革的副产品，也不只是体制缺乏一致性的证据；它作为运作机制，使文化治理能够在实践中成立，恰恰是通过维持社会主义晚期的内外张力来实现这一点：（1）机构被要求在经济上自给自足，却仍嵌入社会主义再分配结构；（2）文化行动者被迫像企业家一样行事，却置身于一个形式上否认利润和市场竞争的意识形态框架；（3）管理再培训试图生产自我优化的经济行动者，却仍在以政治忠诚为基础、要求行动者作为社会主义干部承担责任的体系内进行；（4）分权承诺更多自主，实践中却扩大报告义务、强化官僚监督，使文书工作成为行政生存的条件。

en: Yet the very durability of these contradictions prompts a reconsideration of the terms through which they are understood. If the coexistence of late-socialist and proto-capitalist or quasi-market logics was, in some sense, a recurring feature of institutional life in the 1980s, can the “four paradoxes” identified here still be considered paradoxes? They are perhaps better conceived as “paradoxical normalcies,” or configurations in which contradiction becomes routinized as a stable condition of governance. Sociological analyses have shown how crises—whether pandemics, regime changes, or policy shifts—disrupt ordinary expectations and generate durable forms of adaptation in which instability itself becomes normalized, a condition increasingly described as characteristic of “post-normal times.”

What appears as exception or breakdown operated instead as an enduring mode of coordination, in which governance was enacted through the very tensions it was presumed to resolve. Instead of providing temporary disruptions or solutions, these dynamics generated institutional practices that were concomitantly unstable and normalized. Alexei Yurchak describes this as the “hypernormalization” of late socialism, where contradictions between ideology and practice were not resolved but institutionalized. Actors continued to follow norms even when they no longer corresponded to lived reality and, consequently, produced a social order that was performatively stable yet structurally fragile.
zh: 然而，这些矛盾本身的持久性，促使我们重新思考理解它们所使用的概念。如果社会主义晚期逻辑与原初资本主义或准市场逻辑的共存，在某种意义上是1980年代机构生活的反复特征，那么这里辨识的‘四种悖论’还能被称为悖论吗？或许更适合把它们理解为‘悖论式常态’，即矛盾常规化、成为稳定治理条件的配置。社会学分析表明，无论是疫情、政体变化还是政策转向，危机都会打破通常预期，并生成持久的适应形式，使不稳定本身正常化；这种状态日益被描述为‘后常态时代’的特征。
看似例外或崩坏的东西，实际上作为一种持久的协调模式运作，治理恰恰通过那些它被认为应当解决的张力而实施。这些动态没有提供暂时的中断或解决办法，而是生成既不稳定又正常化的机构实践。阿列克谢·尤尔恰克将此描述为社会主义晚期的‘超正常化’：意识形态与实践之间的矛盾未被解决，而是被制度化。即使规范不再符合生活现实，行动者仍继续遵循它们，因而生产出一个在展演上稳定、结构上却脆弱的社会秩序。

en: Read more broadly, this observation opens onto wider theoretical and analytical questions about the implications of these findings. Comparatively, much scholarship on self-financing (often framed as “self-management” or “autogestion”) has focused on Hungarian or Yugoslav “market-socialism.” While these models are frequently celebrated as paradigms of worker emancipation and “third-way” politics,

the Romanian case follows a markedly different path. Here, cultural institutions were charged with generating income and channeling earnings back into central and local coffers, thus wiring artistic labor into circuits of socialist austerity and economic redistribution. In the process, the conventional image of state socialism as an all-provident and paternalistic order begins to fracture, as state-artist relations shifted from assumptions of provision and entitlement toward ongoing negotiations over institutional survival. The Romanian experience thus challenges monolithic accounts of state socialism, since it shows that the same rhetoric of self-reliance could crystallize into divergent governance forms elsewhere: emancipatory in Yugoslavia’s self-management model, commodification-driven in Hungary’s “feasible socialism,”
and, in Romania, galvanized by austerity and under intensified bureaucratic control.
zh: 从更广的角度看，这一观察引出关于研究发现意义的更广泛理论和分析问题。比较而言，许多关于自筹经费的研究——常以‘自我管理’或‘自治管理’为框架——聚焦匈牙利或南斯拉夫的‘市场社会主义’。这些模式常被赞誉为工人解放和‘第三条道路’政治的典范，

罗马尼亚却走了明显不同的道路。在这里，文化机构被要求创收，并将所得上缴中央和地方财政，从而把艺术劳动接入社会主义紧缩和经济再分配的循环。随着国家与艺术家的关系从供给与应得权利的假设，转向围绕机构生存的持续协商，国家社会主义作为包揽一切、家长式秩序的惯常形象开始破裂。因此，罗马尼亚经验挑战了将国家社会主义视为单一整体的叙述，因为它显示同一套自立话语在不同地方可以凝结为相异治理形式：在南斯拉夫自我管理模式中带有解放性，在匈牙利‘可行的社会主义’中由商品化驱动，
而在罗马尼亚，则受紧缩推动，处于强化的官僚控制之下。

en: This article also challenges binary readings of socialism and capitalism by showing how market-like rationalities—efficiency, decentralized responsibility, economic calculation, performance evaluation—were cultivated within a centrally planned system that formally repudiated the market. My findings show that market rationalities were already assembled within late-socialist governance itself, lending support to Katherine Verdery’s claim that “entrepreneurship [was] already present in embryo.”

In comparative perspective, more explicit forms of market relations in Hungary revealed a “dual economy,” where centrally administered sectors coexisted with market-oriented initiatives. As Martha Lampland similarly argues for late-socialist Hungary, characteristics retrospectively identified as “capitalist”—individualism, utilitarianism, and economism—were not external to socialism but cultivated by it. The transition to capitalism, Lampland posits, was “significantly furthered by policies of the socialist state,” in which “the full commodification of labor, the final blossoming of commodity fetishism, was achieved by the policies and practices of Hungarian socialism.”

While the Romanian case seemingly presents a similar story, it differs in that it deployed analogous techniques of governance yet never explicitly embraced the language of “market-socialism.” It is precisely this discursive tension between ideological repudiation and practical incorporation that makes Romania an especially productive empirical site for tracing how institutional change was envisioned from above and refracted in everyday practice.
zh: 本文也挑战了社会主义与资本主义的二元解读，说明效率、分散化责任、经济计算和绩效评价等类似市场的理性，如何在一个正式拒斥市场的中央计划体系内部被培育。研究发现表明，市场理性早已在社会主义晚期治理内部被组装起来，支持了凯瑟琳·韦尔德里关于‘企业家精神[当时]已经以胚胎形式存在’的说法。
比较来看，匈牙利更明确的市场关系形式显露出一种‘双重经济’，中央管理部门与市场取向的举措并存。玛莎·兰普兰对社会主义晚期匈牙利也作出类似论证：事后被认作‘资本主义’的个人主义、功利主义和经济主义等特征，并非社会主义的外来物，而是由它培育的。兰普兰认为，向资本主义的过渡‘得到社会主义国家政策的显著推动’，其中‘劳动的充分商品化、商品拜物教的最终绽放，是通过匈牙利社会主义的政策和实践实现的。’
罗马尼亚案例看似讲述类似故事，区别在于它部署了相似的治理技术，却从未明确接纳‘市场社会主义’的语言。正是意识形态拒斥与实践吸纳之间的话语张力，使罗马尼亚成为格外富有解释力的经验场域，可用来追踪制度变革如何自上而下被设想，又如何在日常实践中发生折射。

en: With these insights in mind, this research also unsettles tidy narratives of rupture. As this article has shown, the seeds of market-oriented governance were sown within the very soil of Romanian socialist cultural administration, long before 1989. What we often describe as “neoliberalization” therefore did not emerge out of thin air in the 1990s and later but drew on repertoires already cultivated under late socialism. Seen from this vantage point, the socialist-to-capitalist transition appears less as a clean ideological break than a reconfiguration of preexisting logics, an ongoing process in which seemingly opposed logics were repurposed. This perspective challenges conventional frameworks of “transitology” and theories of “unsettled cultures” or “cultural lag,” and in doing so reveals the internal variegation and mutual entanglement of socialist-capitalist trajectories.
zh: 考虑到这些认识，本研究也动摇了整齐划一的断裂叙事。正如本文所示，远在1989年之前，市场取向治理的种子就已播撒在罗马尼亚社会主义文化行政自身的土壤中。因此，我们通常称作‘新自由主义化’的东西，并非在1990年代及此后凭空出现，而是利用了社会主义晚期已培育的行动方式。从这一视角看，从社会主义到资本主义的转变，与其说是鲜明的意识形态断裂，不如说是既有逻辑的重组，是一个不断将看似对立的逻辑改作他用的过程。这一视角挑战了惯常的‘转型学’框架，以及‘未定型文化’或‘文化滞后’理论，并由此揭示社会主义与资本主义轨迹的内部多样性及相互纠缠。

en: Under no circumstances should the entanglements at the center of this research be read as predetermined trajectories, as if the transition to capitalism was inevitable. The events of 1989, often retrospectively folded into narratives of transition, sit uneasily within teleological readings of change. Rather than a linear passage toward “the end of history,” late-socialist paradoxes reveal historically contingent processes in which economic rationalities and political strategies were actively made and remade in practice. In this sense, late socialism rehearsed (some of) the very logics that would later define post-socialist capitalism. My empirical material indicates that the architects of post-communist “transition economics” did not start from a

. Instead, the expansion of the private sector in the 1990s was grounded in practices cultivated under the paradoxical governance of the 1980s, even if these practices were embedded in fundamentally different property regimes and institutional logics.
zh: 无论如何，都不应把本研究核心的纠缠关系读成预定轨迹，仿佛转向资本主义不可避免。1989年的事件常被事后纳入转型叙事，却难以安置在目的论式的变迁解读中。社会主义晚期的悖论并不呈现一条线性通向‘历史终结’的道路，而揭示具有历史偶然性的过程：经济理性与政治策略在实践中被积极创造和重塑。从这个意义上说，社会主义晚期预演了后来将界定后社会主义资本主义的某些逻辑。我的经验材料表明，后共产主义‘转型经济学’的设计者并不是从
开始。相反，1990年代私营部门的扩张，根植于1980年代悖论式治理下培育的实践，尽管这些实践原本嵌入根本不同的产权制度与制度逻辑。

en: How cultural actors carried late-socialist dispositions into post-socialist capitalism is nevertheless less a question of linear continuity than of structural resonance: skills of improvisation and resource-seeking retained value after 1989, when the transition produced an even more exacerbated, contradiction-filled “Darwinist race” in which social differentiation deepened and inequality was more acutely reframed as individual responsibility.

If neoliberal reforms drew not only on external pressures or Western models but also on dispositions formed under socialism, then a key analytical question concerns how these continuities were actively reproduced in practice. Although this line of inquiry lies beyond the scope of the present study, pursuing it would help clarify how capacities accumulated under late socialism enabled some actors to seize new opportunities while leaving others increasingly marginalized: what post-socialist society split into the transition’s proverbial winners and losers.
zh: 然而，文化行动者如何把社会主义晚期形成的倾向带入后社会主义资本主义，与其说是线性延续问题，不如说是结构共鸣问题：临机应变与寻找资源的技能，在1989年后仍有价值，因为转型带来一场更加激烈、充满矛盾的‘达尔文式竞赛’，社会分化加深，不平等更尖锐地被重新表述为个人责任。
如果新自由主义改革不仅依靠外部压力或西方模式，也依靠社会主义下形成的倾向，那么关键的分析问题便在于：这些连续性如何在实践中被主动再生产。虽然这条研究路径超出本文范围，沿着它推进，将有助于阐明社会主义晚期积累的能力，如何使一些行动者抓住新机会，却让另一些人日益边缘化，形成后社会主义社会中人们常说的转型赢家与输家。

en: When read alongside recent debates in the sociology of crisis and social change, my findings underscore the importance of understanding large-scale transformations as relational and historically situated processes. In the late-socialist case, change unfolded amid intersecting crises of oil, energy, debt, and political legitimacy.

Just as literary critic Costi Rogozanu places the aesthetics of Romanian postmodernism in the 1980s as inseparable from the oil crisis, the broader reorganization of cultural production must likewise be situated within this wider landscape of overlapping crises.
zh: 结合危机与社会变迁社会学近期的争论来看，我的发现强调，应将大规模转型理解为关系性的、处于特定历史情境中的过程。在社会主义晚期，变化发生于石油、能源、债务和政治正当性危机的交会之中。
文学评论家科斯蒂·罗戈扎努认为，1980年代罗马尼亚后现代主义美学与石油危机不可分离；同样，文化生产更广泛的重组，也必须放在这一多重危机重叠的更大背景下理解。

en: And crisis sits at the core of the four paradoxes, ultimately revealing how the self-financing regime was itself deeply entangled with it. Rather than a single external rupture, crisis both preceded the introduction of the self-financing regime (and, in part, precipitated it) and was reconfigured through its mechanisms, which at times temporarily contained it while at others generated new instabilities. This imbrication points to a mutually constitutive crisis formation, in which the self-financing regime both produced and was reproduced by the very economic and institutional logics it sought to manage. These dynamics operated in two directions at once: on the one hand, they made austerity governable; on the other, they helped generate the conditions under which the otherwise unimaginable collapse of socialism became thinkable. As Yurchak famously observed, “everything was forever, until it was no more,” thereby casting late socialism as at once “stagnating and immutable, fragile and vigorous, bleak and full of promise.”
zh: 危机居于四种悖论的核心，最终揭示自筹经费体制本身如何与危机深深纠缠。危机不是单次外部断裂：它既先于自筹经费体制的引入，并在一定程度上促成后者，也经由后者的机制被重新塑造；这些机制有时暂时遏制危机，有时又生成新的不稳定。这种交叠指向一种相互构成的危机形态：自筹经费体制既生产它所试图管理的经济和制度逻辑，也由同一套逻辑再生产。这些动态同时朝两个方向运作：一方面使紧缩可被治理，另一方面帮助生成条件，使原本无法想象的社会主义崩溃变得可以想象。正如尤尔恰克那句著名的话，‘一切都是永恒的，直到不再如此’，由此把社会主义晚期呈现为同时‘停滞而不可改变、脆弱而充满活力、阴郁而满怀希望’。

en: Nevertheless, an important distinction deserves to be made. If Rogozanu argues that 1980s postmodern literature became “an ingenious solution for representation in times of austerity,”

this research shows that transformations inside the late-socialist cultural field were not merely aesthetic or representational but profoundly material. To a similar end, scholars like Krisztina Fehérváry reveal that in late socialism “political subjectivities were shaped through daily experience with the state.”

I extend this insight by arguing that cultural actors’ subjectivities were likewise formed through the daily, routinized experience of late-socialist austerity. In fact, their formation can be seen as a reaction to a broader political economy of scarcity in which administrators and artists navigated not just the self-financing regime but the austere rhythms of global capitalist turbulence.
zh: 不过，有一个重要区别值得指出。如果罗戈扎努认为1980年代的后现代文学成为‘紧缩时代再现问题的一种巧妙解决办法’，
那么本研究表明，社会主义晚期文化场域内部的转变，不只是审美或再现层面的，而是深刻的物质性转变。克里斯蒂娜·费赫瓦里等学者也从类似方向揭示，在社会主义晚期，‘政治主体性通过日常与国家打交道的经验而形成’。
我将这一认识延伸，认为文化行动者的主体性也同样通过日常化、常规化的社会主义晚期紧缩经验而形成。事实上，这种形成可以被视为对更广泛的稀缺政治经济的回应：管理者和艺术家不仅要应对自筹经费体制，也要应对全球资本主义动荡带来的紧缩节奏。

en: Katherine Verdery’s analysis is once again useful here, particularly her insistence on deeper historicization. Her perspective highlights how socialism’s strategic reorganization was intricately entangled with global capitalism, which produced long-term and often unintended consequences. In this frame of reference, 1989 appears less as a point of rupture than as a node in a longer continuum of crisis management, whose pivotal fountainhead can be traced back to the late 1960s and early 1970s. This was “when global capitalism entered the cyclical crisis from which it is still struggling to extricate itself,”
a structural upheaval whose effects reverberated across both socialist and capitalist forms of governance alike.
zh: 凯瑟琳·韦尔德里的分析在这里再次有所助益，尤其是她对深入历史化的坚持。她的视角强调，社会主义的战略重组如何与全球资本主义复杂纠缠，产生长期且往往意料之外的后果。在这一参照框架中，1989年与其说是断裂点，不如说是更漫长危机管理连续过程中的一个节点，其关键源头可追溯到1960年代末和1970年代初。那时‘全球资本主义进入了一场周期性危机，至今仍在奋力摆脱’，
这一结构性剧变的影响，在社会主义与资本主义的治理形式中同样回荡。

en: The article’s analytical strategy of reading institutional change through paradox helps highlight how states govern across ideological divides through similar logics of crisis management. Although the analysis does not address post-socialism directly, it traces the formation of a deeper capitalist genealogy, described as “a slow naturalization of free market culture,”

and shows how techniques associated with neoliberal governance were already incubated within late socialism’s attempts to manage economic breakdown. In a somewhat ironic twist, Ceaușescu morphs into a kind of neoliberal austerity figure

: his economic measures of the 1980s prefigured the crisis-management playbook of the 2000s more than they mirrored the Western neoliberalism of his own decade. Unlike Western neoliberal regimes of his time, such as Reagan’s United States, which combined deregulation with deficit-financed military and consumer expansion,

Ceaușescu’s Romania saw salvation in radical contraction and pursued debt elimination at the direct expense of its own population. The drive to repay foreign debt through extreme austerity thus anticipated forms of fiscal restraint only later utilized in neoliberal crisis management.
zh: 本文通过悖论阅读制度变迁的分析策略，有助于凸显国家如何跨越意识形态分野，通过类似的危机管理逻辑进行治理。虽然分析不直接处理后社会主义时期，却追踪了一条更深层资本主义谱系的形成，即‘自由市场文化缓慢自然化’的过程，
并表明与新自由主义治理相关的技术，早已孕育于社会主义晚期应对经济崩坏的努力之中。略带讽刺的是，齐奥塞斯库仿佛变成了一种
新自由主义紧缩人物：他1980年代的经济措施，与其说映照了同时代西方新自由主义，不如说更预示了2000年代的危机管理套路。与里根治下美国等当时西方新自由主义体制不同——后者把放松管制与赤字融资的军事及消费扩张结合起来——
齐奥塞斯库的罗马尼亚把救赎寄托在激进收缩上，直接以本国民众为代价追求消除债务。因此，通过极端紧缩偿还外债的冲动，预示了后来才在新自由主义危机管理中采用的财政约束形式。

en: In similar fashion, imperatives of accountability and efficiency once framed as socialist moral duties now operate as neoliberal techniques of governance. In contemporary capitalist cultural production, these norms persist as artistic and institutional value is routinely measured in terms of profitability and quantifiable outcomes. Ironically, the meanings we attach to these imperatives of success ripple and fracture across time and regimes. They reveal a fluid and contested terrain where governance, economy, and social life intersect. It is precisely in this oscillation of meaning across political and economic regimes that a lingering paradox once again unsettles the appearance of absolute schism: demands that the likes of Ungureanu once deemed “an absurdity” under late socialism have since become part of the normalized grammar of artistic and institutional success in contemporary cultural industries.
zh: 同样，曾被表述为社会主义道德义务的问责和效率要求，如今作为新自由主义治理技术运行。在当代资本主义文化生产中，这些规范持续存在，艺术和机构价值经常以盈利能力及可量化成果来衡量。讽刺的是，我们赋予这些成功要求的意义，跨越时间与制度而不断波动、断裂，揭示出治理、经济和社会生活交会的流动且充满争议的领域。恰恰在不同政治经济体制之间这种意义摆动中，一个挥之不去的悖论再次动摇绝对断裂的表象：温古雷亚努等人在社会主义晚期曾认为‘荒谬’的要求，如今已成为当代文化产业中艺术与机构成功的常态化语法的一部分。

en: Neoliberal capitalism—or whatever contemporary mutant iteration currently operates under its name—has absorbed many of the technologies of governance it once claimed to supersede by rearticulating them in new regimes of value. Yet, as the late-socialist self-financing regime suggests, beyond entanglement and hybridity, and beyond shifting ideologies and institutional forms, there lies a more enduring condition: crisis itself. Less an episodic disruption than an enduring horizon of governance, crisis emerges as a remarkably persistent feature of everyday life, a continuous condition that individuals and institutions alike have to navigate across economic systems or shifting cultural regimes.
zh: 新自由主义资本主义——或者当前以这一名称运行的任何变异版本——把它一度声称将要超越的许多治理技术吸收进来，在新的价值体制中重新表述它们。然而，正如社会主义晚期自筹经费体制所提示的，在纠缠与混合之外，在意识形态和制度形式的变动之外，还存在一种更持久的条件：危机本身。危机与其说是偶发的中断，不如说是治理持久的地平线；它显现为日常生活中极为顽固的特征，一种持续的处境，个人和机构跨越经济体系或变化中的文化体制，都必须设法应对。

en: Although archival records describe this shift as a revised “economic-financial mechanism,” I refer to it here as the “self-financing regime.” The term captures three interlinked dimensions. First, it marks a new expectation that culture should sustain itself: institutions were required to internalize economic logics, meet income targets, and generate their own revenues. Second, the prefix self- (or
-) signaled a turn toward personal responsibility, a form of accountability resonant with logics later associated with neoliberal responsibilization. Third, calling it a
underscores that this was not a minor technical adjustment but a structured system of governance. Romanian reform discourse in the 1980s framed this system through the triptych
(sometimes extended to include
), a paradigm centered on autonomous self-management, institutional responsibility, financial self-sufficiency, and local resource mobilization.

en: Fast-forward to April 1989, when Ceaușescu announced the complete liquidation of Romania’s external debt, hailed as a civilizational triumph that secured independence (“economic, political, and of thought”) from the IMF and the capitalist West. Ștefan Buzărnescu, “Convorbiri cu Dumitru Ghișe,”

, 10 November 1989, 3. Archival sources reinforced this exceptionalist narrative, contrasting Romania’s repayment of $21 billion (over $7 billion in interest) between 1975 and 1989 with the “fabulously high” $1,320 billion still owed by other countries. These documents do two things at once: record economic facts and perform the state’s preferred storyline: Romania succeeded where others failed because it found a way out. That “way out”—collective sacrifice coupled with economic rationalization through the self-financing regime—was presented as the foundation of a sovereigntist national teleology. Bojan, Ioan, “Independența economică și politică a României,” Revista Steaua, 1 May 1989, 1.

en: In a

address, Finance Minister Petre Gigea cast culture as both an economic asset and an instrument for legitimating austerity. Cultural institutions were expected to cultivate a “spirit of economy, prudence, restraint,” while educational initiatives promoted moderation and self-discipline. Reframing this ethos as “economizing in the interest of all and for the benefit of each,” Gigea highlighted national campaigns such as “The Week of Economic Prudence” and “The Day of the Economical Student,” which aimed to instill frugality as both personal duty and collective good. In the context of (inter)national austerity, scarcity itself was recast as civic virtue. Gigea, Petre, “Spiritul de economie, în folosul fiecăruia, în interesul general,” Scînteia, 25 Oct. 1985, 5.
zh: 财政部长彼得雷·吉贾在
